LanguageData.LP_SuccubusAppetite.label: succubus appetite
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusAppetite.description: Succubi live by draining others' energy and eat very little real food: hunger rate ×20%.
LanguageData.LP_Nauseated.label: nauseated
LanguageData.LP_Nauseated.description: The hezrou's stench makes you want to throw up: manipulation -20%, move speed ×0.9.
LanguageData.LP_NabassuPetrify.label: petrifying
LanguageData.LP_NabassuPetrify.description: The nabassu's gaze makes limbs stiff as stone: move speed ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraHidden.label: shadow blend
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraHidden.description: The motionless barlgura has melted into the shadows.
LanguageData.LP_SoulDevoured.label: soul devoured
LanguageData.LP_SoulDevoured.description: A nabassu devoured this person's soul: they can never be resurrected by any means.
LanguageData.LP_SoulGorged.label: soul-gorged
LanguageData.LP_SoulGorged.description: Swallowed souls churn inside it: +5% health per stack (damage taken reduced proportionally), +5% damage, up to 10 stacks.
LanguageData.LP_QuasitNature.label: quasit familiar
LanguageData.LP_QuasitNature.description: A familiar summoned by an abyssal ritual: invisible when not fighting; while master and familiar are on the same map, psychic sensitivity +10% and abyssal taint +0.3% per day.
LanguageData.LP_QuasitVeil.label: invisible
LanguageData.LP_QuasitVeil.description: When not fighting, the quasit cannot be seen.
LanguageData.LP_QuasitBond.label: familiar pact
LanguageData.LP_QuasitBond.description: The quasit is by my side, and the whispers of the Abyss are clearer: psychic sensitivity +10%.
